title: Vastu Architect AI
description: AI-powered floor plan generator that creates Vastu-compliant architectural drawings from a text prompt. Features BSP layout engine, room-by-room compliance scoring, 3D visualization, fire evacuation pathfinding (A*), crowd simulation with CO₂ analysis, sun path analysis, seismic risk mapping (IS 1893:2016), and AutoCAD DXF export.

title: NirmAI — Construction Cost Intelligence
description: AI chatbot for civil engineers and homeowners. Reads DSR/SSR government rate documents and answers rate queries instantly. Features rate analysis generation, BOQ preparation, running bill verification, and a natural language home construction budget estimator backed by Maharashtra PWD SSR 2023-24 data.

title: VeriJob AI
description: An AI-powered job verification platform that detects ghost jobs and scams. Features include legitimacy scoring, salary insights, and smart interview prep.

title: Credit Risk Prediction Model
description: Engineered a machine learning pipeline to predict loan defaults, improving risk assessment accuracy. Deployed as an interactive web app using Streamlit.

title: AI Career Orchestrator
description: An intelligent agent simulating a career coach. Orchestrates tasks to optimize job applications and career planning using LLM workflows.

title: Construction Material Price Tracker
description: Architected an end-to-end data pipeline to track volatile material costs for civil engineering projects using SQL and Power BI.

title: Housing Market Trends Analysis
description: Queried 1M+ rows of housing data in BigQuery to identify undervalued investment opportunities and visualized regional price trends.
